facts.fact: Punch reports the existing Nigerian fibre backbone at about 35,000 km, to be extended to roughly 125,000 km by Project BRIDGE; dated to the article's publication date as it gives no other.

systems.country_label: Project BRIDGE (Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth)
systems.owner: Bridge Open Access SPV, government minority stake

note: Rollout to begin October 2026, funding raised but no contract or works begun, so not building.
